title: The Cracked Mirror
scene: At 4:40 PM, the salon gilt mirror was cracked. A storm locked the back room from 4:20 to 5:00.

suspects.name: Lena Ash
suspects.testimony: I was cutting hair at station two at 4:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The station camera shows Lena scissors at 4:39.

suspects.name: Ravi Cole
suspects.testimony: I was at the shampoo bowl at 4:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The bowl log shows Ravi's station occupied at 4:38.

suspects.name: Uma Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 4:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk camera shows Uma at 4:41.

suspects.name: Greta Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the back room at 4:40, fetching towels.
suspects.contradiction: The back room was locked from outside, and mirror glass was in Greta's shoe.
